stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para Justiça Eleitoral investigar diretor da PF por beneficiar Lula

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro asks Electoral Justice to investigate Federal Police director for benefiting Lula
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro has requested that the Electoral Justice investigate a Federal Police director, alleging that the official's actions benefited former president Lula.

stories.title: Jovem é morto a tiros e Palmas chega a quarta morte em uma semana

en.title: Young man shot dead as Palmas reaches fourth death in one week
en.summary: A 28-year-old man was killed in Palmas, marking the fourth homicide in the city within seven days. Authorities are investigating the incident.

stories.title: Corregedor derruba decisão que suspendeu canal Exército do Lula

en.title: Electoral ombudsman overturns decision that suspended 'Lula's Army' channel
en.summary: The electoral ombudsman reversed a suspension of a WhatsApp channel supporting Lula's reelection campaign that had been ordered by another court official.

stories.title: Relator no TSE derruba decisão de Nunes Marques e mantém canal ‘Exército do Lula’ no WhatsApp

en.title: Rapporteur at TSE overturns Nunes Marques' decision and maintains 'Lula's Army' channel on WhatsApp
en.summary: A court rapporteur overturned a previous decision to suspend a WhatsApp channel supporting Lula's reelection campaign, allowing it to remain active.

stories.title: Corregedor do TSE derruba censura de Kassio e libera canal pró-Lula criado por Janones

en.title: TSE Ombudsman Overturns Kassio's Censorship and Releases Pro-Lula Channel Created by Janones
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court ombudsman restored a WhatsApp channel called "Lula's Army" managed by federal deputy André Janones after it had been previously censored.

stories.title: O que se sabe sobre o jovem morto com 27 tiros durante abordagem policial em SP?

en.title: What is Known About the Young Man Killed With 27 Shots During Police Approach in SP?
en.summary: A young man was killed with 27 shots during a police encounter in São Paulo.

stories.title: Flávio reúne Tarcísio e prefeitos em SP e diz esperar Justiça Eleitoral mais ágil contra fake news

en.title: Flávio Meets Tarcísio and Mayors in SP and Says He Expects Faster Electoral Justice Against Fake News
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro met with Tarcísio and mayors in São Paulo, stating his expectation that electoral courts will act more quickly against what he described as misinformation from the opposing campaign.

stories.title: Presidente critica decisão de Nunes Marques de derrubar canal ‘Exército do Lula’ no WhatsApp

en.title: President Criticizes Nunes Marques' Decision to Take Down 'Lula's Army' Channel on WhatsApp
en.summary: Brazil's president criticized a judicial decision by Nunes Marques that removed the 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel.

stories.title: Janones denuncia censura em decisão do TSE contra Exército do Lula

en.title: Janones denounces censorship in TSE decision against Lula's Army
en.summary: Federal deputy André Janones criticized the Supreme Electoral Court's decision to suspend the WhatsApp channel 'Lula's Army' following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign.

stories.title: TSE atende Flávio e manda suspender canal do whatsapp Exército do Lula

en.title: TSE attends to Flávio and orders suspension of Lula's Army WhatsApp channel
en.summary: The Supreme Electoral Court president ordered the suspension of the 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel, which had approximately 3.3 million members, following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign.

stories.title: Nunes Marques atende pedido de Flávio e derruba canal ‘Exército do Lula’ no WhatsApp

en.title: Nunes Marques attends Flávio's request and removes 'Lula's Army' channel on WhatsApp
en.summary: The Supreme Electoral Court president ordered the suspension of the 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign.

stories.title: Flávio pede investigação contra chefe da PF por suspeita de crime eleitoral

en.title: Flávio requests investigation against PF chief on suspicion of electoral crime
en.summary: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint against Andrei Rodrigues, the Federal Police director-general, alleging electoral crime.

stories.title: Aplicativos avançam sobre compra de reposição de alimentos e higiene e desafiam frequência nos supermercados

en.title: Apps advance on replacement purchases of food and hygiene items and challenge supermarket frequency
en.summary: Mobile applications are competing with supermarkets for repeat purchases of staple goods and hygiene products that drive customer store visits. This shift could reduce retailer sales and impulse purchases that strengthen customer relationships.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro pede investigação de diretor da PF por entrevista no primeiro turno

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign requests investigation of PF director for interview in first round
en.summary: The campaign of Flávio Bolsonaro filed a complaint with the electoral court against the Federal Police director for statements made during a press conference regarding investigation into alleged foreign interference in elections.

stories.title: Flávio diz que sofreu 'pré-julgamento' por pedido de dinheiro a Vorcaro para filme sobre Bolsonaro

en.title: Flávio says he suffered 'prejudgment' over request for money to Vorcaro for film about Bolsonaro
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro stated he was prejudged following revelations about soliciting funds from a former banker for a documentary about former president Jair Bolsonaro, while denying any irregularities.

stories.title: TSE abre investigação sobre Marçal e site que oferecia criptomoedas para promover campanha de Flávio

en.title: TSE opens investigation into Marçal and website offering cryptocurrency to promote Flávio's campaign
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court opened an investigation into an influencer for alleged false information about the president and a website that offered cryptocurrency rewards to users sharing content favoring a presidential candidate's campaign.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula não autorizou drones de entidades para calcular estimativa de público na Paulista

en.title: Lula's campaign did not authorize drones from organizations to calculate public attendance estimate on Paulista Avenue
en.summary: Research organizations stated they did not release a crowd estimate for Lula's reelection rally on Paulista Avenue because the PT campaign did not authorize drone flights over the location due to security protocols.
